explication: Ferrite is a native desktop editor for Markdown and structured text. The user opens or creates a document, edits it in the custom editor or Markdown rendered mode, and can preview, search, and export it; workspace, session, and settings features support that work. The graph also preserves documented Mermaid, CSV, code execution, terminal, spellcheck, and export capabilities. Connections are limited to README statements and SOURCE INDEX references; several feature implementations were not sampled, so their internal calls are not asserted.
